paragraphs: The Vito 116-124 CDI is the current diesel range for the W447, a high-volume, current-production commercial vehicle with genuine ongoing demand. The range spans a 2.0L turbo-diesel engine from the entry-level Vito 114 (100kW/300Nm) up to the top-shelf V300 Exclusive (174kW/500Nm). Across the W447 generation, the Vito has used two distinct engines: the OM651 in early models, and the OM654 in the current 2025 refresh range.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace M256 engines for every VITO 116-124 CDI on the road.

cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the VITO 116-124 CDI from 2023 to present. The M256 features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older M276 V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every M256 rebuild.

compatibility.intro: Because the W447 Vito 116-124 CDI range spans two distinct engines, fitting the wrong replacement — or assuming an OM651 part will work on an OM654 van — risks a compatibility problem. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm: - Your exact engine code (OM651 or OM654) via registration or VIN - Your generation (early W447 or refreshed 2025) - Drivetrain and ancillary specification - Any electronics or ECU considerations specific to your exact build
